  simp +zetaDelta at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Complex.isIntegral_rat_I ℚ
  · intro a ha
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (q3 a : ℚ), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C _ two_ne_zero
    · norm_num [← Polynomial.C_pow]
      norm_cast
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt <| Nat.cast_nonneg _]
      ring

noncomputable instance (g : ℕ) : NumberField (Kf g) :=
  { to_charZero := inferInstance
    to_finiteDimensional := Kf_finiteDimensional g }

theorem Kf_isTotallyComplex (g : ℕ) : NumberField.IsTotallyComplex (Kf g) := by
  have hI : Complex.I ∈ Kf g :=
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  refine ⟨fun v => ?_⟩
  rw [← NumberField.InfinitePlace.not_isReal_iff_isComplex]
  intro hreal
  have hφ : NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v.embedding = v.embedding :=
    NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.mp
      (NumberField.InfinitePlace.isReal_iff.mp hreal)
  set x : Kf g := ⟨Complex.I, hI⟩ with hx
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 = -1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    push_cast [hx, sq, Complex.I_mul_I]
    ring
  set z : ℂ := v.embedding x with hz
  have key : z ^ 2 = -1 := by
    rw [hz, ← map_pow, hx2, map_neg, map_one]
  have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ) z = z := by
    have := RingHom.congr_fun hφ x
    simpa [hz, NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq] using this
  have him : z.im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj
  have hre : z.re ^ 2 = -1 := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re key
    simp only [pow_two, Complex.mul_re, him, mul_zero, sub_zero, Complex.neg_re,
      Complex.one_re] at h
    rw [← pow_two] at h
    exact h
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.re, hre]

noncomputable instance (g : ℕ) : NumberField.IsTotallyComplex (Kf g) :=
  Kf_isTotallyComplex g

name: Erdos.q3_log_sum_le
statement:
theorem q3_log_sum_le : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ g : ℕ, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range g, Real.log (q3 j) ≤
      C * (g + 1) * Real.log (g + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N, (q3 j : ℝ) ≤ (j + 2) ^ 2 := by
    exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mp ( q3_poly_bound );
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ Real.log (q3 j) := fun j =>
    Real.log_nonneg (mod_cast (q3_spec j).1.one_lt.le)
  set A := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Real.log (q3 j) with hA
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hnn j
  refine ⟨A / Real.log 2 + 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro g
  have hL : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (g + 2) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg g : (0:ℝ) ≤ g)])
  have hg0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ g := Nat.cast_nonneg g
  have hLp : 0 ≤ Real.log (g + 2) := hlog2.le.trans hL
  have hAL : A ≤ A / Real.log 2 * Real.log (g + 2) := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hlog2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL hA0
  by_cases hg : g ≤ N
  · calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range g, Real.log (q3 j) ≤ A :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hg) fun j _ _ => hnn j
      _ ≤ A / Real.log 2 * Real.log (g + 2) := hAL
      _ ≤ (A / Real.log 2 + 2) * (g + 1) * Real.log (g + 2) := by
          have h1 : 0 ≤ A / Real.log 2 := by positivity
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 hg0) hLp, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ g + 1) hLp]
  · have hg := not_le.mp hg
    have h_tail : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico N g, Real.log (q3 j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico N g, 2 * Real.log (g + 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hj1, hj2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj
      have h1 : Real.log (q3 j) ≤ Real.log ((j + 2) ^ 2) :=
        Real.log_le_log (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (q3_spec j).1.pos) (hN j hj1)
      rw [Real.log_pow] at h1
      have h2 : Real.log ((j:ℝ) + 2) ≤ Real.log (g + 2) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by have : (j:ℝ) ≤ g := by exact_mod_cast hj2.le
                                            linarith)
      push_cast at h1
      linarith
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, nsmul_eq_mul] at h_tail
    have hNg : (N:ℝ) ≤ g := by exact_mod_cast hg.le
    rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hg.le]
    have hcast : ((g - N : ℕ) : ℝ) = g - N := Nat.cast_sub hg.le
    rw [hcast] at h_tail
    have h3 : (g - N : ℝ) * (2 * Real.log (g + 2)) ≤ 2 * (g + 1) * Real.log (g + 2) := by
      have : (0:ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg N
      nlinarith
    nlinarith

end Erdos
context:
set_option linter.all false -- [Emissary] lints are not drift; the kernel decides

open scoped Classical
open Filter

namespace Erdos

/-- The `j`-th prime congruent to `3` modulo `4` (must match
`Framework.lean` verbatim). -/
noncomputable def q3 (j : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) j

/-- The `i`-th prime congruent to `1` modulo `4` (must match
`Framework.lean` verbatim). -/
noncomputable def p1 (i : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 1) i

theorem conv_sum (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, f d * g (n / d) =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f d * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N / d), g m := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm' (t' := Finset.Icc 1 N) (s' := fun d => (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n))]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hd).1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun n => n / d) (fun m => d * m) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn ⊢
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩ := hn
      exact ⟨Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h3) (by omega), Nat.div_le_div_right h2⟩
    · intro m hm
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hm ⊢
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨⟨Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega), ?_⟩, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩
      exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left d h2) (Nat.mul_div_le N d)
    · intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn
      exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' hn.2
    · intro m hm
      exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left m (by omega)
    · intro n hn; rfl
  · intro n d
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.mem_divisors, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h3
      have h5 := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos h3 (by omega)
      exact ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, by omega, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4, h5⟩
      exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, by omega⟩

theorem sum_log_eq (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log n =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  have h := conv_sum (fun d => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d) (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) N
  simp only [mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel, nsmul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [← h]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  exact (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_sum).symm

theorem prod_Icc_fact (N : ℕ) : ∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (n:ℝ) = N.factorial := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih, Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast; ring

theorem sum_Icc_zero_eq (f : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, f n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n := by
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hx ⊢; omega
  · intro x hx hx'
    have : x = 0 := by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hx hx'; omega
    rw [this]; exact h0

noncomputable def Kpsi : ℝ := Real.log 4 + 4

theorem Kpsi_pos : 0 < Kpsi := by
  unfold Kpsi
  have : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  linarith

theorem psi_sum_le (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≤ Kpsi * N := by
  have h := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0:ℝ) ≤ N)
  rw [Chebyshev.psi_eq_sum_Icc, Nat.floor_natCast,
    sum_Icc_zero_eq _ (by simp)] at h
  exact h

theorem mertens_bounds (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Real.log N - 1 ≤ ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d ∧
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d ≤ Real.log N + Kpsi := by
  have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hA := sum_log_eq N
  have hA1 : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log n ≤ N * Real.log N := by
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log n ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log N := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro n hn
          have := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
          exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast this.1) (by exact_mod_cast this.2)
      _ = N * Real.log N := by simp
  have hA2 : (N:ℝ) * Real.log N - N ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log n := by
    have hprod : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log n = Real.log (N.factorial : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.log_prod]
      · rw [prod_Icc_fact]
      · intro n hn
        have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
        exact_mod_cast (by omega : n ≠ 0)
    rw [hprod]
    have h1 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (N:ℝ) hNpos.le N
    have hfpos : (0:ℝ) < N.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos N
    have h2 : Real.log ((N:ℝ)^N / N.factorial) ≤ N := by
      calc Real.log ((N:ℝ)^N / N.factorial) ≤ Real.log (Real.exp N) :=
            Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h1
        _ = N := Real.log_exp _
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) hfpos.ne', Real.log_pow] at h2
    linarith
  have hM : (N:ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((N:ℝ) / d) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    ring
  have hup : ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (N:ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d := by
    rw [hM]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro d hd
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_div_le) ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
  have hlow : (N:ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d -
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≤
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hM, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro d hd
    have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hd).1
    have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd1
    have : (N:ℝ) < ((N / d : ℕ) + 1) * d := by
      have := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ N hd1
      have h2 : N < (N / d + 1) * d := by nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast h2
    have h3 : (N:ℝ) / d - 1 ≤ ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [div_sub_one hdpos.ne', div_le_iff₀ hdpos]
      linarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (n := d))
    linarith
  have hpsi := psi_sum_le N
  constructor
  · by_contra hcon
    have hcon := not_le.mp hcon
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon hNpos
    nlinarith
  · by_contra hcon
    have hcon := not_le.mp hcon
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon hNpos
    nlinarith

noncomputable def chi (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n % 4 = 1 then 1 else if n % 4 = 3 then -1 else 0

theorem chi_mul (m n : ℕ) : chi (m * n) = chi m * chi n := by
  unfold chi
  have h := Nat.mul_mod m n 4
  rcases (by omega : m % 4 = 0 ∨ m % 4 = 1 ∨ m % 4 = 2 ∨ m % 4 = 3) with h1 | h1 | h1 | h1 <;>
  rcases (by omega : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3) with h2 | h2 | h2 | h2 <;>
  simp [h, h1, h2]

theorem chi_abs_le (n : ℕ) : |chi n| ≤ 1 := by
  unfold chi; split_ifs <;> simp

noncomputable def gg (n : ℕ) : ℝ := Real.log n / n

theorem gg_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ gg n := by
  unfold gg
  exact div_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

theorem gg_le_one (n : ℕ) : gg n ≤ 1 := by
  unfold gg
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · have hp : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    rw [div_le_one hp]
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp
    linarith

theorem gg_anti (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : gg (n + 1) ≤ gg n := by
  unfold gg
  have hn' : (3:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < n := by linarith
  push_cast
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hpos]
  have h1 : Real.log ((n:ℝ) + 1) - Real.log n ≤ 1 / n := by
    rw [← Real.log_div (by linarith) hpos.ne']
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < ((n:ℝ) + 1) / n by positivity)
    have h2 : ((n:ℝ) + 1) / n - 1 = 1 / n := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have h3 : 1 ≤ Real.log n := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos]
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  have h4 : (n:ℝ) * (Real.log ((n:ℝ) + 1) - Real.log n) ≤ 1 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hpos.le
    calc _ ≤ (n:ℝ) * (1 / n) := this
      _ = 1 := by field_simp
  nlinarith

theorem gg_anti2 (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : gg (n + 2) ≤ gg n :=
  le_trans (gg_anti (n+1) (by omega)) (gg_anti n hn)

noncomputable def TT (N : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, chi n * gg n

theorem TT_succ (N : ℕ) : TT (N + 1) = TT N + chi (N + 1) * gg (N + 1) := by
  unfold TT
  rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]

theorem TT_block (k : ℕ) : -1 ≤ TT (4 * k + 4) ∧ TT (4 * k + 4) + gg (4 * k + 5) ≤ 1 := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h4 : TT 4 = - gg 3 := by
      unfold TT
      simp [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top, chi, gg]
    have := gg_le_one 3
    have := gg_nonneg 5
    have := gg_le_one 5
    simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    rw [h4]
    constructor <;> linarith [gg_nonneg 3]
  | succ k ih =>
    have c1 : chi (4 * k + 5) = 1 := by unfold chi; rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    have c2 : chi (4 * k + 6) = 0 := by unfold chi; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have c3 : chi (4 * k + 7) = -1 := by unfold chi; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
    have c4 : chi (4 * k + 8) = 0 := by unfold chi; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have s1 : TT (4 * k + 5) = TT (4 * k + 4) + chi (4 * k + 5) * gg (4 * k + 5) := TT_succ (4 * k + 4)
    have s2 : TT (4 * k + 6) = TT (4 * k + 5) + chi (4 * k + 6) * gg (4 * k + 6) := TT_succ (4 * k + 5)
    have s3 : TT (4 * k + 7) = TT (4 * k + 6) + chi (4 * k + 7) * gg (4 * k + 7) := TT_succ (4 * k + 6)
    have s4 : TT (4 * k + 8) = TT (4 * k + 7) + chi (4 * k + 8) * gg (4 * k + 8) := TT_succ (4 * k + 7)
    rw [c1] at s1
    rw [c2] at s2
    rw [c3] at s3
    rw [c4] at s4
    have a1 : gg (4 * k + 7) ≤ gg (4 * k + 5) := gg_anti2 (4 * k + 5) (by omega)
    have a2 : gg (4 * k + 9) ≤ gg (4 * k + 7) := gg_anti2 (4 * k + 7) (by omega)
    have a3 := gg_nonneg (4 * k + 7)
    show -1 ≤ TT (4 * k + 8) ∧ TT (4 * k + 8) + gg (4 * k + 9) ≤ 1
    constructor <;> linarith [ih.1, ih.2]

theorem TT_bound (N : ℕ) : |TT N| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [abs_le]
  obtain ⟨k, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ k r, r < 4 ∧ N = 4 * k + r := ⟨N / 4, N % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num), by omega⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · have g3 := gg_le_one 3
    have g2 := gg_nonneg 3
    have g1 : gg 1 = 0 := by simp [gg]
    interval_cases r
    · simp [TT]
    · simp [TT, chi, g1]
    · simp [TT, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top, chi, g1]
    · simp [TT, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top, chi, g1] <;> (constructor <;> linarith)
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hb := TT_block j
    have e : 4 * (j + 1) = 4 * j + 4 := by ring
    rw [e]
    have c1 : chi (4 * j + 5) = 1 := by unfold chi; rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    have c2 : chi (4 * j + 6) = 0 := by unfold chi; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have c3 : chi (4 * j + 7) = -1 := by unfold chi; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
    have s1 : TT (4 * j + 5) = TT (4 * j + 4) + chi (4 * j + 5) * gg (4 * j + 5) := TT_succ (4 * j + 4)
    have s2 : TT (4 * j + 6) = TT (4 * j + 5) + chi (4 * j + 6) * gg (4 * j + 6) := TT_succ (4 * j + 5)
    have s3 : TT (4 * j + 7) = TT (4 * j + 6) + chi (4 * j + 7) * gg (4 * j + 7) := TT_succ (4 * j + 6)
    rw [c1] at s1
    rw [c2] at s2
    rw [c3] at s3
    have a1 := gg_nonneg (4 * j + 5)
    have a2 := gg_nonneg (4 * j + 7)
    have a3 := gg_le_one (4 * j + 5)
    have a4 := gg_le_one (4 * j + 7)
    have a5 : gg (4 * j + 7) ≤ gg (4 * j + 5) := gg_anti2 (4 * j + 5) (by omega)
    interval_cases r
    · constructor <;> linarith [hb.1, hb.2]
    · show -1 ≤ TT (4 * j + 5) ∧ TT (4 * j + 5) ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [hb.1, hb.2]
    · show -1 ≤ TT (4 * j + 6) ∧ TT (4 * j + 6) ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [hb.1, hb.2]
    · show -1 ≤ TT (4 * j + 7) ∧ TT (4 * j + 7) ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [hb.1, hb.2]

noncomputable def PP (y : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 y, chi m / m

theorem PP_odd (n : ℕ) : chi (2 * n + 1) = (-1) ^ n := by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' n with ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩
  · unfold chi
    rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    rw [pow_mul]; simp
  · unfold chi
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
    rw [pow_succ, pow_mul]; simp

theorem chi_even (n : ℕ) : chi (2 * n + 2) = 0 := by
  unfold chi
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

theorem PP_eq (n : ℕ) :
    PP (2 * n) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * (1 / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1)) ∧
    PP (2 * n + 1) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * (1 / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [PP, chi]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : PP (2 * n + 1) = PP (2 * n) + chi (2 * n + 1) / ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      unfold PP; rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    have h2 : PP (2 * n + 1 + 1) = PP (2 * n + 1) + chi (2 * n + 1 + 1) / ((2 * n + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      unfold PP; rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    have e1 : 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 := by ring
    have h3 : PP (2 * n + 1 + 1 + 1) = PP (2 * n + 1 + 1) + chi (2 * n + 1 + 1 + 1) / ((2 * n + 1 + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      unfold PP; rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    have c2 : chi (2 * n + 1 + 1) = 0 := chi_even n
    have c3 : chi (2 * n + 1 + 1 + 1) = (-1) ^ (n + 1) := PP_odd (n + 1)
    rw [c2, zero_div, add_zero] at h2
    rw [e1]
    constructor
    · rw [h2]; exact ih.2
    · rw [h3, c3, h2, Finset.sum_range_succ, ih.2]
      push_cast
      ring

theorem PP_err (y : ℕ) (hy : 1 ≤ y) : |PP y - Real.pi / 4| ≤ 2 / y := by
  have ht := Real.tendsto_sum_pi_div_four
  have ht' : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * (1 / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.pi / 4)) :=
    ht.congr (fun n => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (mul_one_div _ _).symm))
  have ha : Antitone (fun i : ℕ => 1 / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1)) := by
    intro a b hab
    have : (a:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hab
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hl := fun k => Antitone.alternating_series_le_tendsto ht' ha k
  have hu := fun k => Antitone.tendsto_le_alternating_series ht' ha k
  set l := Real.pi / 4 with hlv
  have hyy : (1:ℝ) ≤ y := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * (1 / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1)) - l| ≤ 1 / (2 * (m:ℝ) - 1) := by
    intro m hm
    have hm' : (1:ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd' m with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
    · have h1 := hl k
      have h2 := hu k
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h2
      have hp : ((-1:ℝ) ^ (2 * k)) = 1 := by rw [pow_mul]; simp
      rw [hp] at h2
      rw [abs_le]
      push_cast at hm' h2 ⊢
      have h5 : 1 / (2 * (2 * (k:ℝ)) + 1) ≤ 1 / (2 * (2 * (k:ℝ)) - 1) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have h6 : 0 < 1 / (2 * (2 * (k:ℝ)) + 1) := by
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
        positivity
      constructor <;> linarith
    · have h1 := hl k
      have h2 := hu k
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h2
      have hp : ((-1:ℝ) ^ (2 * k)) = 1 := by rw [pow_mul]; simp
      rw [hp] at h2
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hp]
      rw [abs_le]
      push_cast at h2 ⊢
      have h3 : 2 * (2 * (k:ℝ) + 1) - 1 = 2 * (2 * (k:ℝ)) + 1 := by ring
      rw [h3]
      have h6 : 0 < 1 / (2 * (2 * (k:ℝ)) + 1) := by
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
        positivity
      constructor <;> linarith
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' y with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
  · rw [(PP_eq n).1]
    have hn : 1 ≤ n := by omega
    have hn' : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    refine le_trans (key n hn) ?_
    push_cast
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    linarith
  · rw [(PP_eq n).2]
    refine le_trans (key (n+1) (by omega)) ?_
    have hn : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    push_cast
    have h3 : 2 * ((n:ℝ) + 1) - 1 = 2 * n + 1 := by ring
    rw [h3, div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    linarith

noncomputable def SS (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, chi d * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d

theorem TT_eq (N : ℕ) :
    TT N = ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      (chi d * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) * PP (N / d) := by
  have h := conv_sum (fun d => chi d * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d)
    (fun m => chi m / m) N
  unfold PP
  rw [← h]
  unfold TT
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
  calc chi n * gg n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, chi n / n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_sum]; unfold gg; ring
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      obtain ⟨hdn, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hdn
      have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos ⟨e, he⟩ hn1
      have hepos : 0 < e := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos e with h0 | h0
        · subst h0; omega
        · exact h0
      subst he
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left e hdpos, chi_mul]
      have hd' : (d:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hdpos.ne'
      have he' : (e:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hepos.ne'
      push_cast
      field_simp

theorem SS_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) : |SS N| ≤ 2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi) := by
  have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hKp := Kpsi_pos
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun d => chi d * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d with hf
  have h1 : TT N = Real.pi / 4 * SS N +
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f d * (PP (N / d) - Real.pi / 4) := by
    rw [TT_eq]
    unfold SS
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    simp only [hf]
    ring
  have h2 : |∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f d * (PP (N / d) - Real.pi / 4)| ≤ 4 * Kpsi := by
    have h3 : ∀ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        |f d * (PP (N / d) - Real.pi / 4)| ≤ 4 * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / N := by
      intro d hd
      obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hd
      have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd1
      have hy : 1 ≤ N / d := Nat.div_pos hd2 hd1
      have hy' : (1:ℝ) ≤ ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
      have hlt : N < d * (N / d + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ N hd1
      have hlt' : (N:ℝ) ≤ 2 * d * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have : N ≤ 2 * d * (N / d) := by nlinarith
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hL := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (n := d)
      have he := PP_err (N / d) hy
      have hfabs : |f d| ≤ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d := by
        simp only [hf]
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hL, abs_of_pos hdpos]
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hdpos.le
        calc |chi d| * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≤ 1 * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (chi_abs_le d) hL
          _ = _ := one_mul _
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |f d| * |PP (N / d) - Real.pi / 4|
          ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) * (2 / ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul hfabs he (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ 4 * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / N := by
            rw [div_mul_div_comm, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hNpos]
            have : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * 2 * N ≤ 4 * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * (d * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
              nlinarith
            exact this
    calc |∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f d * (PP (N / d) - Real.pi / 4)|
        ≤ ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, |f d * (PP (N / d) - Real.pi / 4)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 4 * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / N := Finset.sum_le_sum h3
      _ = 4 * (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d) / N := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ 4 * Kpsi := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hNpos]
          have := psi_sum_le N
          nlinarith
  have h4 := TT_bound N
  have hpi := Real.pi_gt_three
  rw [abs_le] at h2 h4 ⊢
  have hS : Real.pi / 4 * SS N ≤ 1 + 4 * Kpsi := by linarith [h1, h2.2, h4.2]
  have hS' : -(1 + 4 * Kpsi) ≤ Real.pi / 4 * SS N := by linarith [h1, h2.1, h4.1]
  constructor
  · by_contra hcon
    have hcon := not_le.mp hcon
    nlinarith
  · by_contra hcon
    have hcon := not_le.mp hcon
    nlinarith

noncomputable def EE (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, if n % 2 = 0 then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / n else 0

theorem EE_nonneg (N : ℕ) : 0 ≤ EE N := by
  unfold EE
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro n hn
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  · exact le_refl _

theorem geom_Icc (N : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ((1:ℝ) / 2) ^ k = 1 - (1 / 2) ^ N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
    ring

theorem EE_le_one (N : ℕ) : EE N ≤ 1 := by
  set F : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n % 2 = 0 then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / n else 0 with hF
  have hFnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ F n := by
    intro n
    simp only [hF]
    split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    · exact le_refl _
  set T := (Finset.Icc 1 N).image (fun k => 2 ^ k) with hT
  have hsub : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, n ∉ Finset.Icc 1 N ∩ T → F n = 0 := by
    intro n hn hn'
    by_contra hne
    apply hn'
    refine Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hn, ?_⟩
    have h1 : n % 2 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; apply hne; simp [hF, h]
    have h2 : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hne; simp [hF, h]
    obtain ⟨p, k, hp, hk, rfl⟩ := (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff).mp h2
    have hp' : p.Prime := Nat.prime_iff.mpr hp
    have h2p : 2 ∣ p ^ k := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h1
    have h3 : p = 2 := ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_two hp').mp
      (Nat.prime_two.dvd_of_dvd_pow h2p)).symm
    subst h3
    rw [hT, Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨k, ?_, rfl⟩
    have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).2
    have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := k)
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  calc EE N = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N ∩ T, F n := by
        unfold EE
        symm
        apply Finset.sum_subset Finset.inter_subset_left
        intro n hn hn'
        exact hsub n hn hn'
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ T, F n :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.inter_subset_right (fun n _ _ => hFnn n)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, F (2 ^ k) := by
        rw [hT, Finset.sum_image]
        intro a _ b _ hab
        exact Nat.pow_right_injective (le_refl 2) hab
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log 2 * ((1:ℝ) / 2) ^ k := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        have hk1 : k ≠ 0 := by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1; omega
        simp only [hF]
        rw [if_pos (by rw [Nat.pow_mod]; simp [hk1])]
        rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_pow hk1,
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime Nat.prime_two]
        push_cast
        rw [one_div, inv_pow]
        ring
    _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, geom_Icc]
        have := Real.log_two_lt_d9
        have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ N := by positivity
        have h3 : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
        nlinarith

noncomputable def W3 (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, if n % 4 = 3 then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / n else 0

theorem W3_eq (N : ℕ) :
    W3 N = (1 / 2) * (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d - SS N - EE N) := by
  unfold W3 SS EE
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  unfold chi
  split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | ring

theorem W3_window (N N' : ℕ) (hN' : 1 ≤ N') (hle : N' ≤ N) :
    (1 / 2) * (Real.log N - Real.log N') - (1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi) ≤
      W3 N - W3 N' := by
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := le_trans hN' hle
  rw [W3_eq, W3_eq]
  have m1 := mertens_bounds N hN
  have m2 := mertens_bounds N' hN'
  have s1 := abs_le.mp (SS_bound N hN)
  have s2 := abs_le.mp (SS_bound N' hN')
  have e1 := EE_le_one N
  have e2 := EE_nonneg N'
  have e3 := EE_nonneg N
  have e4 := EE_le_one N'
  linarith [m1.1, m1.2, m2.1, m2.2, s1.1, s1.2, s2.1, s2.2]

theorem count_lower (N N' : ℕ) (hN' : 1 ≤ N') (hle : N' ≤ N) :
    (1 / 2) * (Real.log N - Real.log N') - (1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi) ≤
      Real.log N / N' * (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) (N + 1) : ℝ) +
        2 * Real.sqrt N * Real.log N / N' := by
  refine le_trans (W3_window N N' hN' hle) ?_
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := le_trans hN' hle
  have hN'pos : (0:ℝ) < N' := by exact_mod_cast hN'
  have hsplit : W3 N - W3 N' =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N' N, if n % 4 = 3 then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / n else 0 := by
    unfold W3
    have e : ∀ M : ℕ, Finset.Icc 1 M = Finset.Ioc 0 M := by
      intro M; ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
    rw [e, e, ← Finset.sum_Ioc_consecutive _ (Nat.zero_le N') hle]
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  set A : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ioc N' N).filter (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) with hA
  set B : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ioc 0 N).filter (fun n => ¬ n.Prime) with hB
  have hpt : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N' N,
      (if n % 4 = 3 then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / n else 0) ≤
        (if n ∈ A then Real.log N / N' else 0) +
        (if n ∈ B then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / N' else 0) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hn
    have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < n)
    have hnN' : (N':ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
    have hnN : (n:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hn2
    have hL := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (n := n)
    have hlogN : 0 ≤ Real.log N := Real.log_natCast_nonneg N
    by_cases h3 : n % 4 = 3
    · rw [if_pos h3]
      by_cases hp : n.Prime
      · have hnA : n ∈ A := by rw [hA]; simp only [Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hn, hp, h3⟩
        have hnB : n ∉ B := by rw [hB]; simp [hp]
        rw [if_pos hnA, if_neg hnB, add_zero,
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
        calc Real.log n / n ≤ Real.log N / n :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.log_le_log hnpos hnN) hnpos.le
          _ ≤ Real.log N / N' :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hlogN hN'pos hnN'.le
      · have hnB : n ∈ B := by
          rw [hB]; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc]; exact ⟨⟨by omega, hn2⟩, hp⟩
        have hnA : n ∉ A := by rw [hA]; simp [hp]
        rw [if_neg hnA, if_pos hnB, zero_add]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL hN'pos hnN'.le
    · rw [if_neg h3]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ (if n ∈ A then Real.log N / N' else 0) := by
        split_ifs
        · exact div_nonneg hlogN hN'pos.le
        · exact le_refl _
      have h2 : 0 ≤ (if n ∈ B then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / N' else 0) := by
        split_ifs
        · exact div_nonneg hL hN'pos.le
        · exact le_refl _
      linarith
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum hpt) ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply add_le_add
  · rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hcard : (((Finset.Ioc N' N).filter (fun n => n ∈ A)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) (N + 1) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
      have : ((Finset.Ioc N' N).filter (fun n => n ∈ A)) ⊆
          (Finset.range (N + 1)).filter (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) := by
        intro n hn
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_range, hA] at hn ⊢
        exact ⟨by omega, hn.2.2⟩
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card this
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcard (div_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg N) hN'pos.le)
  · have h1 : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N' N, (if n ∈ B then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / N' else 0) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N, (if n ∈ B then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / N' else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hx ⊢; omega
      · intro n _ _
        split_ifs
        · exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg hN'pos.le
        · exact le_refl _
    refine le_trans h1 ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    have h2 : ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 N).filter (fun n => n ∈ B), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / N' =
        (Chebyshev.psi N - Chebyshev.theta N) / N' := by
      rw [Chebyshev.psi_sub_theta_eq_sum_not_prime, Nat.floor_natCast, ← Finset.sum_div]
      congr 2
      ext n
      simp [hB]
    rw [h2]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hN'pos.le
    have := Chebyshev.psi_sub_theta_le (x := (N:ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hN)
    exact this

theorem count_big (a : ℕ) (ha : 4096 ≤ a)
    (hL : 8 * ((1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi)) ≤ Real.log a) :
    2 * a ≤ Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) (a ^ 2 + 1) := by
  set C5 : ℝ := (1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi) with hC5
  set b := Nat.sqrt a with hb
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 ≤ a := Nat.sqrt_le' a
  have hb64 : 64 ≤ b := by
    rw [hb, Nat.le_sqrt']; omega
  have hba : b ≤ a := by nlinarith
  have hapos : (0:ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < a)
  have hbpos : (0:ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < b)
  have key := count_lower (a ^ 2) (a * b) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)) (by nlinarith)
  set c : ℝ := (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) (a ^ 2 + 1) : ℝ) with hc
  push_cast at key
  set L := Real.log a with hLdef
  have hlog1 : Real.log ((a:ℝ) ^ 2) = 2 * L := by rw [Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
  have hlog2 : Real.log ((a:ℝ) * b) = L + Real.log b := Real.log_mul hapos.ne' hbpos.ne'
  have hlog3 : 2 * Real.log b ≤ L := by
    have : Real.log ((b:ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ Real.log a :=
      Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hb2)
    rw [Real.log_pow] at this
    push_cast at this
    linarith
  have hsq : Real.sqrt ((a:ℝ) ^ 2) = a := Real.sqrt_sq hapos.le
  rw [hlog1, hlog2, hsq] at key
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith [Kpsi_pos, show (0:ℝ) ≤ 0 from le_refl 0, hL,
    show 0 < (1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi) by nlinarith [Kpsi_pos]]
  set X : ℝ := (a:ℝ) * b with hX
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by positivity
  have hR : 2 * L / X * c + 2 * a * (2 * L) / X = (2 * L * c + 4 * a * L) / X := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [hR] at key
  have k2 : L / 8 ≤ (2 * L * c + 4 * a * L) / X := by
    refine le_trans ?_ key
    linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hXpos] at k2
  have k3 : L * (X / 8) ≤ L * (2 * c + 4 * a) := by nlinarith
  have k4 : X / 8 ≤ 2 * c + 4 * a := le_of_mul_le_mul_left k3 hLpos
  have hb64' : (64:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb64
  have hX2 : 64 * (a:ℝ) ≤ X := by rw [hX]; nlinarith
  have h5 : (2 * a : ℝ) ≤ c := by linarith
  have h6 : ((2 * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) (a ^ 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; exact h5
  exact_mod_cast h6

theorem infinite_setOf_q3 : {n | n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3}.Infinite := by
  have h : {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ p ≡ 3 [MOD 4]}.Infinite :=
    Nat.infinite_setOf_prime_and_modEq (by norm_num) (by decide)
  convert! h using 2 with n

theorem q3_spec (j : ℕ) : (q3 j).Prime ∧ q3 j % 4 = 3 :=
  Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite infinite_setOf_q3 j

/-- Eventually the `j`-th prime `≡ 3 mod 4` is at most `(j+2)²`. -/
theorem q3_poly_bound : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop, (q3 j : ℝ) ≤ ((j : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ : ∃ a0 : ℕ, 4096 ≤ a0 ∧ ∀ a : ℕ, a0 ≤ a →
      8 * ((1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi)) ≤ Real.log a := by
    refine ⟨max 4096 ⌈Real.exp (8 * ((1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi)))⌉₊,
      le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    have h1 : Real.exp (8 * ((1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi))) ≤ a := by
      have := Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp (8 * ((1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi))))
      have h2 : ((⌈Real.exp (8 * ((1 / 2) * (2 + 2 * (2 * (1 + 4 * Kpsi)) + Kpsi)))⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ a := by
        exact_mod_cast le_trans (le_max_right _ _) ha
      linarith
    have h3 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) h1
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h3
  refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨a0, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have hja : a0 ≤ j + 2 := by omega
  have hc := count_big (j + 2) (le_trans ha0.1 hja) (ha0.2 _ hja)
  have hjc : j < Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) ((j + 2) ^ 2 + 1) := by omega
  have hnth : Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) j < (j + 2) ^ 2 + 1 :=
    Nat.nth_lt_of_lt_count hjc
  have : q3 j ≤ (j + 2) ^ 2 := by
    unfold q3; omega
  calc (q3 j : ℝ) ≤ (((j + 2) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    _ = ((j : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring

/-- Helper for `log_classNumber_Kf_le`: a uniform bound on the partial sums
`∑_{j<g} log (q3 j)`, deduced from the polynomial bound `q3_poly_bound`. -/

name: Erdos.log_classNumber_le_log_discr
statement:
theorem log_classNumber_le_log_discr : ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧
    ∀ g : ℕ, Real.log (NumberField.classNumber (Kf g)) ≤
      a * Real.log |(NumberField.discr (Kf g) : ℝ)| + b
context:
set_option linter.all false
open scoped Classical

namespace Erdos

noncomputable def q3 (j : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) j

noncomputable def Kf (g : ℕ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ :=
  IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
    (insert Complex.I ((fun j => ((Real.sqrt (q3 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) '' Set.Iio g))

theorem Kf_finiteDimensional (g : ℕ) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (Kf g) := by
  refine' IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin _
  simp +zetaDelta at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Complex.isIntegral_rat_I ℚ
  · intro a ha
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (q3 a : ℚ), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C _ two_ne_zero
    · norm_num [← Polynomial.C_pow]
      norm_cast
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt <| Nat.cast_nonneg _]
      ring

noncomputable instance (g : ℕ) : NumberField (Kf g) :=
  { to_charZero := inferInstance
    to_finiteDimensional := Kf_finiteDimensional g }

theorem Kf_isTotallyComplex (g : ℕ) : NumberField.IsTotallyComplex (Kf g) := by
  have hI : Complex.I ∈ Kf g :=
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  refine ⟨fun v => ?_⟩
  rw [← NumberField.InfinitePlace.not_isReal_iff_isComplex]
  intro hreal
  have hφ : NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v.embedding = v.embedding :=
    NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.mp
      (NumberField.InfinitePlace.isReal_iff.mp hreal)
  set x : Kf g := ⟨Complex.I, hI⟩ with hx
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 = -1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    push_cast [hx, sq, Complex.I_mul_I]
    ring
  set z : ℂ := v.embedding x with hz
  have key : z ^ 2 = -1 := by
    rw [hz, ← map_pow, hx2, map_neg, map_one]
  have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ) z = z := by
    have := RingHom.congr_fun hφ x
    simpa [hz, NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq] using this
  have him : z.im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj
  have hre : z.re ^ 2 = -1 := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re key
    simp only [pow_two, Complex.mul_re, him, mul_zero, sub_zero, Complex.neg_re,
      Complex.one_re] at h
    rw [← pow_two] at h
    exact h
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.re, hre]

noncomputable instance (g : ℕ) : NumberField.IsTotallyComplex (Kf g) :=
  Kf_isTotallyComplex g

theorem Kf_one_lt_finrank (g : ℕ) : 1 < Module.finrank ℚ (Kf g) := by
  have h_deg : 2 * NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces (Kf g) = Module.finrank ℚ (Kf g) := by
    rw [ NumberField.IsTotallyComplex.finrank ];
  linarith [ show 0 < NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces ( Kf g ) from by linarith [ show 0 < Module.finrank ℚ ( Kf g ) from Module.finrank_pos ] ] ;

theorem tele_prod (B : ℕ) :
    ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) ≤ 2 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos B with rfl | hB
  · simp
  have key : ∀ B : ℕ, 1 ≤ B →
      ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) = (2 : ℝ) * (B : ℝ) / ((B : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro B hB
    induction B, hB using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => norm_num
    | succ B hB ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
      have hB' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast hB
      push_cast
      have h1 : ((B : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 - 1 = B * (B + 2) := by ring
      rw [h1]
      have : (B : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have : (B : ℝ) + 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have : (B : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      ring
  rw [key B hB]
  have hB' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  linarith

theorem prod_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p N : ι → ℕ) (B n : ℕ)
    (hp2 : ∀ i, 2 ≤ p i) (hpN : ∀ i, p i ≤ N i) (hpB : ∀ i, p i ≤ B)
    (hfib : ∀ q, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q)).card ≤ n) :
    ∏ i, ((N i : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((N i : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun x => (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((x : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) with hf
  have hf_eq : ∀ x : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → f x = 1 + 1 / ((x : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hx
    have : (x : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
    simp only [hf]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hf1 : ∀ x : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → 1 ≤ f x := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hx
    rw [hf_eq x hx]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
    have := one_div_pos.mpr this
    linarith
  have hfanti : ∀ x y : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ y → f y ≤ f x := by
    intro x y hx hxy
    rw [hf_eq x hx, hf_eq y (le_trans hx hxy)]
    have hx' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hx
    have hxy' : (x : ℝ) ≤ y := by exact_mod_cast hxy
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
    have : 1 / ((y : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) ≤ 1 / ((x : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le h0 (by nlinarith)
    linarith
  have step1 : ∏ i, f (N i) ≤ ∏ i, f (p i) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro i _
      exact le_trans zero_le_one (hf1 _ (le_trans (hp2 i) (hpN i)))
    · intro i _
      exact hfanti _ _ (hp2 i) (hpN i)
  have step2 : ∏ i, f (p i) = ∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q)).card := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.Icc 2 B) (g := p)
      (fun i _ => Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨hp2 i, hpB i⟩)]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro q _
    rw [← Finset.prod_const]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2]
  have step3 : ∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q)).card
      ≤ ∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q ^ n := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro q hq
      exact pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (hf1 _ (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).1)) _
    · intro q hq
      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (hf1 _ (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).1) (hfib q)
  have step4 : ∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q ^ n = (∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q) ^ n := by
    rw [Finset.prod_pow]
  have step5 : (∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q) ≤ 2 := tele_prod B
  have step6 : (∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, f q) ^ n ≤ 2 ^ n :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Finset.prod_nonneg fun q hq =>
      le_trans zero_le_one (hf1 _ (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).1)) step5 n
  calc ∏ i, ((N i : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((N i : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) = ∏ i, f (N i) := rfl
    _ ≤ _ := step1
    _ = _ := step2
    _ ≤ _ := step3
    _ = _ := step4
    _ ≤ _ := step6

theorem sum_le_prod {α ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F : Finset α) (e : α → ι → ℕ)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn e F) (E : ℕ) (hE : ∀ a ∈ F, ∀ i, e a i ≤ E)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∀ i, w i < 1) (g : α → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ a ∈ F, g a = ∏ i, w i ^ e a i) :
    ∑ a ∈ F, g a ≤ ∏ i, (1 - w i)⁻¹ := by
  calc ∑ a ∈ F, g a = ∑ a ∈ F, ∏ i, w i ^ e a i := Finset.sum_congr rfl hg
    _ = ∑ x ∈ F.image e, ∏ i, w i ^ x i :=
      (Finset.sum_image (f := fun x : ι → ℕ => ∏ i, w i ^ x i) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : ι => Finset.range (E + 1)), ∏ i, w i ^ x i := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hx
        rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
        intro i
        exact Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hE a ha i))
      · intro x _ _
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hw0 i) _
    _ = ∏ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), w i ^ j :=
      (Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : ι => Finset.range (E + 1)) (fun i j => w i ^ j)).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ i, (1 - w i)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro i _
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => pow_nonneg (hw0 i) _
      · intro i _
        have h1w : 0 < 1 - w i := by linarith [hw1 i]
        have := mul_neg_geom_sum (w i) (E + 1)
        rw [← one_div, le_div_iff₀ h1w]
        rw [mul_comm]
        linarith [pow_nonneg (hw0 i) (E + 1)]

theorem real_bound (a q d : ℝ) (r n : ℕ) (ha2 : a ^ 2 ≤ 2) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hr : r ≤ n) (B : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (hB : B ≤ a ^ r * (q * Real.sqrt d)) :
    B ^ 2 * 2 ^ n ≤ d * 4 ^ n := by
  have h1 : B ^ 2 ≤ (a ^ r * (q * Real.sqrt d)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hB0 hB 2
  have hpw : (a ^ r) ^ 2 = (a ^ 2) ^ r := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  have h2 : (a ^ r * (q * Real.sqrt d)) ^ 2 = (a ^ 2) ^ r * (q ^ 2 * d) := by
    calc (a ^ r * (q * Real.sqrt d)) ^ 2 = (a ^ r) ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt d) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = (a ^ 2) ^ r * (q ^ 2 * d) := by rw [hpw, Real.sq_sqrt hd]
  have h3 : (a ^ 2) ^ r ≤ 2 ^ n :=
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg a) ha2 r).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hr)
  have h4 : q ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hq0 hq1
  have h5 : B ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ n * d := by
    calc B ^ 2 ≤ (a ^ 2) ^ r * (q ^ 2 * d) := h1.trans h2.le
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (1 * d) :=
        mul_le_mul h3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 hd) (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = 2 ^ n * d := by ring
  have h4n : (4 : ℝ) ^ n = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := by
    rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  calc B ^ 2 * 2 ^ n ≤ (2 ^ n * d) * 2 ^ n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 (by positivity)
    _ = d * 4 ^ n := by rw [h4n]; ring

section NF
open NumberField

theorem exists_prime_mem_of_natCast {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hP : P.IsPrime) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, m ≠ 0 → m ≠ 1 → (m : 𝓞 K) ∈ P → ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ P := by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro h0 h1 hm
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqm⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd h1
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hqm
    by_cases hk : k = 1
    · subst hk
      exact ⟨q, hq, by simpa using hm⟩
    · push_cast at hm
      rcases hP.mem_or_mem hm with h | h
      · exact ⟨q, hq, h⟩
      · have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at h0
        refine ih k ?_ hk0 hk h
        have := hq.two_le
        have : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
        nlinarith

theorem dvd_absNorm_of_mem {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (P : Ideal (𝓞 K))
    (hP : P.IsPrime) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ P) :
    p ∣ Ideal.absNorm P := by
  by_contra hnd
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime p (Ideal.absNorm P) := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).2 hnd
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hcop
  have h1 : ((a : 𝓞 K) * (p : 𝓞 K) + (b : 𝓞 K) * (Ideal.absNorm P : 𝓞 K)) = 1 := by
    have := congrArg (Int.cast : ℤ → 𝓞 K) hab
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  have hN : ((Ideal.absNorm P : ℕ) : 𝓞 K) ∈ P := Ideal.absNorm_mem P
  have : (1 : 𝓞 K) ∈ P := by
    rw [← h1]
    exact P.add_mem (P.mul_mem_left _ hpP) (P.mul_mem_left _ hN)
  exact hP.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one P).2 this)

theorem two_le_absNorm_of_prime {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (P : Ideal (𝓞 K))
    (hP : P.IsPrime) (hne : P ≠ ⊥) : 2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm P := by
  have h0 : Ideal.absNorm P ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.1 h)
  have h1 : Ideal.absNorm P ≠ 1 := fun h => hP.ne_top (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.1 h)
  omega

theorem pow_card_le_absNorm {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (I : Ideal (𝓞 K))
    (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (a : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ P ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I, a ≤ Ideal.absNorm P) :
    a ^ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).card ≤ Ideal.absNorm I := by
  have h1 : Ideal.absNorm I =
      ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).map
        (fun P : Ideal (𝓞 K) => Ideal.absNorm P)).prod := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hI]
    exact map_multiset_prod (Ideal.absNorm : Ideal (𝓞 K) →*₀ ℕ) _
  rw [h1]
  have := Multiset.pow_card_le_prod
    (s := (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).map
        (fun P : Ideal (𝓞 K) => Ideal.absNorm P)) (a := a) (by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hx
    exact h P hP)
  simpa using this

theorem prime_of_mem_nf {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {I P : Ideal (𝓞 K)}
    (h : P ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I) : P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ ⊥ :=
  ⟨Ideal.isPrime_of_prime (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor P h),
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor P h).ne_zero⟩

theorem card_primes_over_le {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (q : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime)
    (S : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (hS : ∀ P ∈ S, P.IsPrime ∧ (q : 𝓞 K) ∈ P) :
    S.card ≤ Module.finrank ℚ K := by
  have hq0 : (q : 𝓞 K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne_zero
  set J : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Ideal.span {(q : 𝓞 K)} with hJ
  have hJne : J ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [hJ, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact hq0
  have hsub : S ⊆ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).toFinset := by
    intro P hP
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hJne]
    exact ⟨(hS P hP).1, (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).2 (hS P hP).2⟩
  have hcard1 : S.card ≤ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).card :=
    (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _)
  have hNJ : Ideal.absNorm J = q ^ Module.finrank ℚ K := by
    rw [hJ, Ideal.absNorm_span_singleton]
    have : ((q : ℕ) : 𝓞 K) = algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K) (q : ℤ) := by simp
    rw [this, Algebra.norm_algebraMap, NumberField.RingOfIntegers.rank]
    simp [Int.natAbs_pow]
  have hpow : q ^ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).card ≤ Ideal.absNorm J := by
    apply pow_card_le_absNorm J hJne
    intro P hP
    obtain ⟨hPp, hPne⟩ := prime_of_mem_nf hP
    have hle : J ≤ P := ((Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hJne).1 hP).2
    have hqP : (q : 𝓞 K) ∈ P := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).1 hle
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hPne (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.1 h)))
      (dvd_absNorm_of_mem P hPp q hq hqP)
  rw [hNJ] at hpow
  by_contra hlt
  have hlt' := not_le.1 hlt
  have := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hq.one_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt' hcard1)
  exact absurd hpow (not_le.2 this)

theorem classNumber_le_bound (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    (NumberField.classNumber K : ℝ) ≤ |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)| * 4 ^ Module.finrank ℚ K := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ P : Ideal (𝓞 K), P.IsPrime → P ≠ ⊥ → ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ P := by
    intro P hP hne
    apply exists_prime_mem_of_natCast P hP (Ideal.absNorm P)
    · exact fun h => hne (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.1 h)
    · exact fun h => hP.ne_top (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.1 h)
    · exact Ideal.absNorm_mem P
  set n := Module.finrank ℚ K with hn
  set Mr : ℝ := (4 / Real.pi) ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K *
      ((n.factorial : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ n * √|(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)|) with hMr
  set B : ℕ := ⌊Mr⌋₊ with hB
  have hMr0 : 0 ≤ Mr := by positivity
  have hBM : (B : ℝ) ≤ Mr := Nat.floor_le hMr0
  have hfin : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) | I ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm I ≤ B}.Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.range (B + 1)).finite_toSet
      (fun m _ => Ideal.finite_setOfPred_absNorm_eq m)) ?_
    intro I hI
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
    exact ⟨Ideal.absNorm I, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hI.2, rfl⟩
  set F := hfin.toFinset with hF
  have hFmem : ∀ I, I ∈ F ↔ I ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm I ≤ B := by
    intro I; simp [hF]
  have step1 : NumberField.classNumber K ≤ F.card := by
    choose ψ hψ using fun C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K) => NumberField.exists_ideal_in_class_of_norm_le C
    have hψne : ∀ C, (ψ C : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≠ ⊥ := fun C => by
      simpa using nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero (ψ C).2
    have hψB : ∀ C, Ideal.absNorm (ψ C : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ B := fun C =>
      Nat.le_floor (hψ C).2
    have : Fintype.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) ≤ F.card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_univ]
      apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun C => (ψ C : Ideal (𝓞 K)))
      · intro C _
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, hFmem]
        exact ⟨hψne C, hψB C⟩
      · intro C _ D _ h
        rw [← (hψ C).1, ← (hψ D).1]
        congr 1
        exact Subtype.ext h
    simpa [NumberField.classNumber] using this
  have step2 : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 ^ n := by
    set Pr : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := F.filter (fun P => P.IsPrime) with hPr
    have hFprime_mem : ∀ P ∈ Pr, P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm P ≤ B := by
      intro P hP
      rw [hPr, Finset.mem_filter, hFmem] at hP
      exact ⟨hP.2, hP.1.1, hP.1.2⟩
    let e : Ideal (𝓞 K) → ↥Pr → ℕ := fun I P =>
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count P.1
    have hprod : ∀ I ∈ F, I = ∏ P : ↥Pr, (P.1) ^ e I P := by
      intro I hI
      have hIne := ((hFmem I).1 hI).1
      have hIB := ((hFmem I).1 hI).2
      have hsub : (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).toFinset ⊆ Pr := by
        intro P hP
        rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hP
        obtain ⟨hPp, hPne⟩ := prime_of_mem_nf hP
        have hle : I ≤ P := ((Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hIne).1 hP).2
        have hdvd := Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le hle
        have hI0 : Ideal.absNorm I ≠ 0 := fun h => hIne (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.1 h)
        rw [hPr, Finset.mem_filter, hFmem]
        exact ⟨⟨hPne, (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hI0) hdvd).trans hIB⟩, hPp⟩
      calc I = (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).prod :=
            (Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hIne).symm
        _ = ∏ P ∈ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).toFinset,
              P ^ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count P :=
            Finset.prod_multiset_count _
        _ = ∏ P ∈ Pr, P ^ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count P := by
            apply Finset.prod_subset hsub
            intro P _ hP
            rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hP
            rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.2 hP, pow_zero]
        _ = ∏ P : ↥Pr, (P.1) ^ e I P :=
            (Finset.prod_coe_sort Pr
              (fun P => P ^ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count P)).symm
    have hE : ∀ I ∈ F, ∀ P : ↥Pr, e I P ≤ B := by
      intro I hI P
      have hIne := ((hFmem I).1 hI).1
      have hIB := ((hFmem I).1 hI).2
      have h2 := pow_card_le_absNorm I hIne 2 (fun Q hQ => by
        obtain ⟨hQp, hQne⟩ := prime_of_mem_nf hQ
        exact two_le_absNorm_of_prime Q hQp hQne)
      have hlt : (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).card <
          2 ^ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).card := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      have := Multiset.count_le_card P.1 (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I)
      show (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count P.1 ≤ B
      omega
    have hinj : Set.InjOn e (F : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) := by
      intro I hI J hJ h
      calc I = ∏ P : ↥Pr, (P.1) ^ e I P := hprod I hI
        _ = ∏ P : ↥Pr, (P.1) ^ e J P := by
            apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
            intro P _
            rw [show e I P = e J P from congrFun h P]
        _ = J := (hprod J hJ).symm
    let w : ↥Pr → ℝ := fun P => (((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
    have hN2 : ∀ P : ↥Pr, 2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm P.1 := fun P =>
      two_le_absNorm_of_prime P.1 (hFprime_mem P.1 P.2).1 (hFprime_mem P.1 P.2).2.1
    have hw0 : ∀ P, 0 ≤ w P := fun P => by positivity
    have hw1 : ∀ P, w P < 1 := by
      intro P
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Ideal.absNorm P.1 := by exact_mod_cast hN2 P
      show (((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ < 1
      apply inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀
      nlinarith
    let g : Ideal (𝓞 K) → ℝ := fun I => (((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
    have hg : ∀ I ∈ F, g I = ∏ P : ↥Pr, w P ^ e I P := by
      intro I hI
      have h1 := congrArg (fun J : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm J : ℕ)) (hprod I hI)
      simp only [map_prod, map_pow] at h1
      have h2 : ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          ∏ P : ↥Pr, ((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ e I P := by
        exact_mod_cast h1
      show (((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ = _
      rw [h2, ← Finset.prod_pow, ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro P _
      simp only [w]
      rw [inv_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
    have hsum : ∑ I ∈ F, g I ≤ ∏ P : ↥Pr, (1 - w P)⁻¹ :=
      sum_le_prod F e hinj B hE w hw0 hw1 g hg
    have hprodle : ∏ P : ↥Pr, (1 - w P)⁻¹ ≤ 2 ^ n := by
      have hrew : ∀ P : ↥Pr, (1 - w P)⁻¹ =
          (((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / (((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) := by
        intro P
        have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Ideal.absNorm P.1 := by exact_mod_cast hN2 P
        have h4 : ((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
        have h5 : ((Ideal.absNorm P.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
        simp only [w]
        field_simp
      rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun P _ => hrew P)]
      choose pf hpf using fun P : ↥Pr =>
        hex P.1 (hFprime_mem P.1 P.2).1 (hFprime_mem P.1 P.2).2.1
      have hpfN : ∀ P : ↥Pr, pf P ≤ Ideal.absNorm P.1 := fun P =>
        Nat.le_of_dvd (by have := hN2 P; omega)
          (dvd_absNorm_of_mem P.1 (hFprime_mem P.1 P.2).1 (pf P) (hpf P).1 (hpf P).2)
      apply prod_bound pf (fun P => Ideal.absNorm P.1) B n
      · intro P; exact (hpf P).1.two_le
      · exact hpfN
      · intro P; exact (hpfN P).trans (hFprime_mem P.1 P.2).2.2
      · intro q
        by_cases hq : q.Prime
        · have := card_primes_over_le q hq
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun P : ↥Pr => pf P = q)).image Subtype.val) (by
              intro P hP
              obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hP
              have hQq : pf Q = q := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hQ).2
              refine ⟨(hFprime_mem Q.1 Q.2).1, ?_⟩
              rw [← hQq]
              exact (hpf Q).2)
          rwa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective] at this
        · have : Finset.univ.filter (fun P : ↥Pr => pf P = q) = ∅ := by
            apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
            intro P _ h
            exact hq (h ▸ (hpf P).1)
          rw [this]
          simp
    have hcard : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ I ∈ F, g I := by
      calc (F.card : ℝ) = ∑ I ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ I ∈ F, (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * g I := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro I hI
          have hIne := ((hFmem I).1 hI).1
          have hIB := ((hFmem I).1 hI).2
          have h1 : 1 ≤ Ideal.absNorm I :=
            Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (fun h => hIne (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.1 h))
          have h1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Ideal.absNorm I := by exact_mod_cast h1
          have h2' : (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast hIB
          show 1 ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹
          rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos (by linarith) 2)]
          nlinarith
        _ = (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ I ∈ F, g I := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ I ∈ F, g I := hcard
      _ ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 ^ n := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum.trans hprodle) (by positivity)
  have step3 : (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 ^ n ≤ |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)| * 4 ^ n := by
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
    have hq1 : (n.factorial : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ n ≤ 1 :=
      div_le_one_of_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow n) (by positivity)
    have hpi : (4 / Real.pi) ^ 2 ≤ 2 := by
      have := Real.pi_gt_three
      have hpos : 0 < Real.pi := by linarith
      rw [div_pow, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have hr2 : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K ≤ n := by
      have := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank K
      omega
    exact real_bound (4 / Real.pi) _ _ _ n hpi hq0 hq1 (abs_nonneg _) hr2 (B : ℝ)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hBM
  calc (NumberField.classNumber K : ℝ) ≤ F.card := by exact_mod_cast step1
    _ ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 ^ n := step2
    _ ≤ _ := step3

end NF

name: Erdos.Kf_aut_sq
statement: theorem Kf_aut_sq (g : ℕ) (σ : Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) : σ ^ 2 = 1
context:
open scoped Classical

namespace Erdos

noncomputable def q3 (j : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) j

noncomputable def Kf (g : ℕ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ :=
  IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
    (insert Complex.I ((fun j => ((Real.sqrt (q3 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) '' Set.Iio g))

name: Erdos.Kf_eq_one_of_fixes_gens
statement:
theorem Kf_eq_one_of_fixes_gens (g : ℕ) (σ : Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g)
    (h : ∀ t : Kf g, (↑t ∈ insert Complex.I ((fun j => ((Real.sqrt (q3 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) '' Set.Iio g))
      → σ t = t) : σ = 1
context:
open scoped Classical

namespace Erdos

noncomputable def q3 (j : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) j

noncomputable def Kf (g : ℕ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ :=
  IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
    (insert Complex.I ((fun j => ((Real.sqrt (q3 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) '' Set.Iio g))

name: Erdos.inertia_fixes_gen
statement:
theorem inertia_fixes_gen (g : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Kf g))) [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (σ : Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) (hσ : ∀ x : 𝓞 (Kf g), σ • x - x ∈ P)
    (t : Kf g) (c : ℤ) (hc : (t : ℂ) ^ 2 = (c : ℂ)) (hpc : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ 4 * c) :
    σ t = t
context:
set_option linter.all false
open scoped Classical

namespace Erdos

noncomputable def q3 (j : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.nth (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 4 = 3) j

noncomputable def Kf (g : ℕ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ :=
  IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
    (insert Complex.I ((fun j => ((Real.sqrt (q3 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) '' Set.Iio g))

theorem Kf_finiteDimensional (g : ℕ) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (Kf g) := by
  refine' IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin _
  simp +zetaDelta at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Complex.isIntegral_rat_I ℚ
  · intro a ha
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (q3 a : ℚ), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C _ two_ne_zero
    · norm_num [← Polynomial.C_pow]
      norm_cast
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt <| Nat.cast_nonneg _]
      ring

noncomputable instance (g : ℕ) : NumberField (Kf g) :=
  { to_charZero := inferInstance
    to_finiteDimensional := Kf_finiteDimensional g }

open scoped NumberField

name: Erdos.Kf_inertia_eq_bot
statement:
theorem Kf_inertia_eq_bot (g : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp4 : p % 4 = 1)
    (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Kf g))) [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    Ideal.inertia (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpz, hp0, hpprime, hpmax, hp4dvd⟩ := p_prime_facts hp hp4
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro σ hσmem
  have hσ : ∀ x : 𝓞 (Kf g), σ • x - x ∈ P := by
    simpa using AddSubgroup.mem_inertia.mp hσmem
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Kf_eq_one_of_fixes_gens g σ
  intro t ht
  rcases ht with ht | ⟨j, hj, ht⟩
  · refine inertia_fixes_gen g p P σ hσ t (-1) ?_ ?_
    · rw [ht]; rw [Complex.I_sq]; push_cast; ring
    · simpa using hp4dvd
  · refine inertia_fixes_gen g p P σ hσ t (q3 j) ?_ ?_
    · rw [← ht, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg (q3 j))]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [show (4 * (q3 j : ℤ)) = ((4 * q3 j : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast,
        Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp]
      push Not
      refine ⟨by simpa using (by exact_mod_cast hp4dvd : ¬ p ∣ (4:ℕ)), ?_⟩
      intro h
      have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (q3_spec j).1).mp h
      have := (q3_spec j).2
      omega

end Erdos

name: Erdos.Kf_ramificationIdxIn_eq_one
statement:
theorem Kf_ramificationIdxIn_eq_one (g : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp4 : p % 4 = 1) :
    Ideal.ramificationIdxIn (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI := Kf_isGalois g
  obtain ⟨hpz, hp0, hpprime, hpmax, hp4dvd⟩ := p_prime_facts hp hp4
  haveI : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).IsMaximal := hpmax
  obtain ⟨⟨P, hPprime, hPlies⟩⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : Nonempty (Ideal.primesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g))))
  haveI := hPprime
  haveI := hPlies
  have hPne : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp0 P
  haveI : P.IsMaximal := hPprime.isMaximal hPne
  haveI : Finite (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ (Int.quotientSpanEquivZMod (p : ℤ)).symm.toEquiv
  haveI : Finite (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := inferInstance
  letI : Field (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  letI : Field (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  haveI : Module.Finite (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := Module.Finite.of_finite
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _
  haveI : PerfectField (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := PerfectField.ofFinite
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := inferInstance
  rw [← Ideal.card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn (G := Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g)
        (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P, Kf_inertia_eq_bot g p hp hp4 P, Subgroup.card_bot]

end Erdos

name: Erdos.Kf_inertiaDegIn_le_two
statement:
theorem Kf_inertiaDegIn_le_two (g : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp4 : p % 4 = 1) :
    Ideal.inertiaDegIn (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ (Kf g) := Kf_isGalois g
  obtain ⟨hpz, hp0, hpprime, hpmax, hp4dvd⟩ := p_prime_facts hp hp4
  haveI : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).IsMaximal := hpmax
  obtain ⟨⟨P, hPprime, hPlies⟩⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : Nonempty (Ideal.primesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g))))
  haveI := hPprime
  haveI := hPlies
  have hPne : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp0 P
  haveI : P.IsMaximal := hPprime.isMaximal hPne
  haveI : Finite (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ (Int.quotientSpanEquivZMod (p : ℤ)).symm.toEquiv
  haveI : Finite (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := inferInstance
  letI : Field (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  letI : Field (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  haveI : Module.Finite (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := Module.Finite.of_finite
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _
  haveI : PerfectField (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := PerfectField.ofFinite
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable (ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) := inferInstance
  have hcard := Ideal.card_stabilizer_eq (G := Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P
  rw [Kf_ramificationIdxIn_eq_one g p hp hp4, one_mul] at hcard
  rw [← hcard]
  have hquot := Ideal.Quotient.stabilizerQuotientInertiaEquiv
    (G := Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P
  have hinbot : Ideal.inertia (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P = ⊥ := Kf_inertia_eq_bot g p hp hp4 P
  have hcard2 : Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P)
      = Nat.card ((𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) ≃ₐ[ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}] (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P)) := by
    have h1 : Nat.card ((Ideal.inertia (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P).subgroupOf
        (MulAction.stabilizer (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P)) = 1 := by
      rw [hinbot, Subgroup.bot_subgroupOf]
      exact Subgroup.card_bot
    rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup
      (s := (Ideal.inertia (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P).subgroupOf
        (MulAction.stabilizer (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) P)), h1, mul_one]
    exact Nat.card_congr hquot.toEquiv
  rw [hcard2]
  have hexp : ∀ x : ((𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) ≃ₐ[ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}] (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P)),
      x ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hquot.surjective x
    obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective y
    have hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [SubgroupClass.coe_pow, OneMemClass.coe_one]
      exact Kf_aut_sq g (σ : Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g)
    rw [← map_pow, ← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, hσ]
    exact map_one hquot
  have hcyc : IsCyclic ((𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) ≃ₐ[ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}] (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P)) :=
    inferInstance
  have hdvd : Nat.card ((𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P) ≃ₐ[ℤ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}] (𝓞 (Kf g) ⧸ P)) ∣ 2 := by
    rw [← IsCyclic.exponent_eq_card]
    exact Monoid.exponent_dvd_of_forall_pow_eq_one hexp
  exact Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd

end Erdos

name: Erdos.Kf_card_primesOver_ge
statement:
theorem Kf_card_primesOver_ge (g : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp4 : p % 4 = 1) :
    2 ^ g ≤ (Ideal.primesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g))).ncard
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ (Kf g) := Kf_isGalois g
  obtain ⟨hpz, hp0, hpprime, hpmax, hp4dvd⟩ := p_prime_facts hp hp4
  haveI : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).IsMaximal := hpmax
  have hfund := Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn
    (p := Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g)) (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g)
  have hG : Nat.card (Kf g ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kf g) = 2 ^ (g + 1) := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Kf_finrank] using IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank ℚ (Kf g)
  have he := Kf_ramificationIdxIn_eq_one g p hp hp4
  have hf := Kf_inertiaDegIn_le_two g p hp hp4
  rw [hG, he, one_mul] at hfund
  have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ^ (g + 1) = 2 ^ g * 2 := by rw [pow_succ]
  nlinarith [(Ideal.primesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g))).ncard.zero_le,
    Nat.zero_le (Ideal.inertiaDegIn (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 (Kf g)))]

end Erdos
